name: Colfenor
description: A treefolk sage whose plots to undermine Oona the clique spies on.

description_citations.text: "Vendilion clique". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Sigric, weakened by poison, tells them they must pass a sleeping giant to reach the veil and rambles about Colfenor.
timeline.quote: It cannot grow where the sun warms its leaves.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: A secret cutting of Colfenor's sapling is saved by Rhys and awakened by a special Rising as Ferrafor, the last yew treefolk.
timeline.quote: Awoken by a special version of the Rising, her first moments were of death and pain.

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Ashling takes a messenger job from Colfenor, gains the Vendilion clique and Brigid Baeli as companions at Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Ashling had accepted a seemingly innocuous messenger job from the treefolk sage Colfenor

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid drenches Ashling, nearly killing her; the greater elemental appears, rekindles her fire and sets Colfenor ablaze.
timeline.quote: A surge of energy from the elemental's blessing rekindled her fire and set Colfenor ablaze, obliterating the yew.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Manipulated by Colfenor's message, Brigid nearly drowns Ashling and attacks Rhys at the Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Brigid nearly drowned Ashling on the banks of the Murmuring Bosk to snuff out her fire, attacked Rhys, and escaped to Kinsbaile with an unconscious, dying Ashling in tow.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath, ending the elvish threat, and Colfenor admits he ordered Brigid's attack to coincide with his rebirth.
timeline.quote: the elvish threat to Kinsbaile was negated when Rhys killed Taercenn Nath in hand-to-hand combat

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teeg dies in flames as Colfenor combusts, though Ashling is saved.
timeline.quote: as he would eventually be set ablaze and die as Colfenor dramatically combusted by way of his own machinations.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor takes Rhys as apprentice and teaches him yew magic.
timeline.quote: Colfenor apprenticed a young Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alerted to a great coming event, Colfenor goes to Kinsbaile to set his plan in motion.
timeline.quote: set in motion a chain of events that would reshape the plane's destiny

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor meets Gaddock Teeg and retains Ashling to reach Rhys, while Oona's Vendilion clique spies on him.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Ashling with reaching his former apprentice, Rhys.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor and Rhys reunite in Kinsbaile, and Colfenor sends him to plant his seed cone at Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Rhys with traveling to Murmuring Bosk

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor learns Brigid was meant to capture Rhys and redirects her to abduct Ashling so as to end his own life.
timeline.quote: Colfenor covertly redirected Brigid to abduct Ashling instead.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor shares the stories of his long life at the Festival of Tales.
timeline.quote: The gathered kithkin put aside their worries and listened with rapt attention

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and her fire engulfs Colfenor, who dies as the last yew despite Rhys's efforts.
timeline.quote: the last yew burned brightly to his death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor's sapling rises one day after his death, greeting the company as her seedfather's heir.
timeline.quote: the young tree had grown, awakened, and "risen" merely one day after Colfenor's death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After her audience with Oona, Maralen conjures fae magic to vanish Gilt-Leaf troops and watches Colfenor die and his sapling be born.
timeline.quote: She then went on to observe the fiery death of Colfenor and the subsequent birth of his sapling

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Meeting her maker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR Oona spies on Colfenor through the Vendilion clique, which she created as scouts.
timeline.quote: a trio of faerie emissaries that she created in the face of the Great Aurora to act as her personal scouts and spies

citation.text: "Oona", section "The final Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overwhelmed by feral boggarts, Rhys invokes Colfenor's magic, causing a poison blast that kills everyone except himself, Gryffid and Nath.
timeline.quote: the result was a ruinous blast of poison that eradicated the forest and killed everyone except Rhys, Gryffid, and Nath

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique find Rhys with a message from Colfenor.
timeline.quote: the flamekin carried a message for him

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor declares Rhys his final pupil and asks him to plant his seed cone in the Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: wishing for him to travel to the Murmuring Bosk and plant his seed cone there

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid, manipulated by Colfenor, lies about Ashling and Sygg and escapes to Kinsbaile with Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid, who was manipulated into the act by Colfenor, escaped to Kinsbaile with Ashling.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and Colfenor burns to death as planned, promising to see Rhys again.
timeline.quote: the rekindling of Ashling by a greater elemental that she was seeking and the fiery demise of Colfenor

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A young treefolk rises at the Bosk a day after Colfenor's death.
timeline.quote: greeting them in the name of her seedfather

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yew treefolk dwindle until only Colfenor remains, whose offspring The Sapling is destroyed by Oona.
timeline.quote: until only one remained: Colfenor , the Last Yew; who only produced The Sapling , which was destroyed by Oona .

citation.text: "Treefolk", section "Yew Treefolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The relic was woven from cast-offs of Colfenor's branches by Sigric.
relations.quote: Woven from cast-offs of Colfenor's branches and infused with ancient magic

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

relations.note: Sigric acts for the yews' revival.
relations.quote: The yew cannot be permitted to die entirely.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

relations.quote: retained the service of a flamekin messenger named Ashling

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Sprouted from Colfenor's seed cone; his offspring.
relations.quote: greeted the company in the name of her "seedfather."

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.
